known_facts: Modern Warfare 4 launched Oct 23, 2026 (PS5, Xbox Series X|S, PC, Switch 2), set on the Korean Peninsula. Season 1 started early Nov 2026: Shoot House and Backstab maps, two new weapons, DMZ zone X01. Nov 10 patch: Scavenger Bonus cash on failed DMZ exfils, X01 UAV nerf, Ghost no longer hides unsuppressed shooters. Joint Fire event: 3x progression in duos, 5x in squads of 3+. Ranked returns in Season 2 for Multiplayer and Warzone.
